fact: A young open cluster in Sagittarius, about 4,000 light-years away, close to the Trifid Nebula in the sky.
bio: Charles Messier discovered it on 5 June 1764. The cluster has at least 105 members and is only a few million years old, a tiny fraction of the Sun's age. At an apparent magnitude of about 6 it is bright enough to be spotted in the smallest binoculars on a dark night.
